name: ESSnuSB
full_name: European Spallation Source neutrino Super Beam
summary: ESSnuSB is a proposed Swedish accelerator-neutrino facility designed to measure CP violation near the second oscillation maximum. ESSnuSB+ develops enabling beam and detector concepts; it is not an operating neutrino-oscillation experiment.
physics_targets: Leptonic CP violation at the second oscillation maximum
Low-energy monitored and stored-muon beam development
detection_principle: An upgraded ESS proton linac and accumulator would feed a pion-production target and horn system. Muon-neutrino and antineutrino beams would be measured with near detectors and a large underground water-Cherenkov detector at a candidate Swedish mine.
